TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Tou naunamou a-koumea ta SOU, ka æ'ïa-qua ki A-lid ta Sou, ka Alid ta Sou [kanna].
S.TRANSL: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
太初有道，道與上帝同在，道就是上帝。

S.FORM: Ta atta æ̈'ïa-qua ki Alid tou naunamou.
S.TRANSL: The same was in the beginning with God.
這道太初與上帝同在。

S.FORM: Ni-pei-ymd-en ta ma-mang ki anna, ka tou äoussi ki anna, assi ni-pei-ring-ei ta sa-sasat ka mamang, ka ni-pei-ring-ei-ra.
S.TRANSL: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
萬物是藉着他造的；凡被造的，沒有一樣不是藉着他造的。

S.FORM: Æ'ïa-qua tou anna ta keuæ̈g-han, ka keuæ̈g-han [kan-na] ta ræmæh ki ka'euloung.
S.TRANSL: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
生命在他裏頭，這生命就是人的光。

S.FORM: Ka mæræmæh ta ræmæh tou karumdum-an, ka assi ni-mi balei ta karumdum-an ki anna.
S.TRANSL: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
光照在黑暗裏，黑暗卻不接受光。

S.FORM: Ni-akoumea ta tau, ka na padadingi ki Alid, ka nanang tyn ta ti Joannes.
S.TRANSL: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
有一個人，是從上帝那裏差來的，名叫約翰。

S.FORM: Teni k'atta ta ni-iroua tou pattæ'i-hail-en, ka pattæ'i-heil-eich tyn ta ræmæh, alei ka tna-ymd-ah tna-msing aley tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
這人來，為要作見證，就是為光作見證，叫眾人因他可以信。

S.FORM: Assi ræmæh ta teni, ra dyk alei ki pattæ'i-hail-eih tyn ki ræmæh-da.
S.TRANSL: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
他不是那光，乃是要為光作見證。

S.FORM: [Teni kanna] ta ræmæh ka d'lligh, ka mæræmæh ym-mud ki ka'eulong ka iroua tou Næi.
S.TRANSL: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
那光是真光，照亮一切生在世上的人。

S.FORM: A'ïa-qua tou Næi ta te-ni, ka ni-pei-ringei tyn ta Næi: ka assi ni-kmalang tyni-æn ta Næy-ra.
S.TRANSL: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
他在世界，世界也是藉着他造的，世界卻不認識他。

S.FORM: Ni-mou-qua ki a-teni, ka assi ni-a-balei [matta-rarijh] ty-ni-æn ta â-teni.
S.TRANSL: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
他到自己的地方來，自己的人倒不接待他。

S.FORM: Papynnapynnà ta ni-a-ba-lei [matta rarijh] tyni-æn, ni-phæn tyn ta ka'ilhg-an keuh-alalak ki Alid, neini-æn ka tna-m'sing ki nanang tyn-da.
S.TRANSL: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
凡接待他的，就是信他名的人，他就賜他們權柄作上帝的兒女。

S.FORM: Ka assi ni-pou-alak-kan na 'æmah, assi na kamoei-in ki vât, assi na kamoei-in ki pæræh, ra na Alid-appa.
S.TRANSL: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
這等人不是從血氣生的，不是從情慾生的，也不是從人意生的，乃是從上帝生的。

S.FORM: Ka ni-kæuh-bât ta Sou, ka ni-itoukaqua ymyt-æn, (ka ni-k'ytta-niæn ta keirangh-en tyn, ta kei-rang-an ki kidi mama ki Pei-sat-en ki Rama-râ) mat'-moei ki kanadap-en, kamam-sing-an appa.
S.TRANSL: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
道成了肉身，住在我們中間，充充滿滿地有恩典有真理。我們也見過他的榮光，正是父獨生子的榮光。

S.FORM: Mattæ'i-hail ta ti Joan-nes tyni-æn, ka ni-pakou-lang'h-gen tyn, koumma, Teni ta ti atta ka ni-qua-au, Teni ka si-æ'uh jau-an, ta ni-kæu'h-ourou jauan, alei ka tou ourou jau-an ako-um-ea ta teni.
S.TRANSL: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
約翰為他作見證，喊着說：「這就是我曾說：『那在我以後來的，反成了在我以前的，因他本來在我以前。』」

S.FORM: Ka tou katmoei-en tyn ni-a-ymd-an-eta mara ta kana-dap-en, ka kmah-tounoutounoun ki kanadap-en-da.
S.TRANSL: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
從他豐滿的恩典裏，我們都領受了，而且恩上加恩。

S.FORM: Alei ka na pæp'æ̈ ti Moses ta Tatouhko, râ kanadap-en ta kamamsing-an appa na pa-va-ftæu [ta anna] ti Jesus Christus.
S.TRANSL: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
律法本是藉着摩西傳的；恩典和真理都是由耶穌基督來的。

S.FORM: Myhkaqua assi ni-kmyt-ta ta ti mamang ki Alid ra: Alak ka pei-sât-en ka itou-qua tou æ̈-i-va ki Rama, teni ta ni tmæuæuh poupænæh [ymyt-æn].
S.TRANSL: No man hath seen God at any time, the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
從來沒有人看見上帝，只有在父懷裏的獨生子將他表明出來。

S.FORM: Ka atta ta patt'æi-hail-en ti Joannes, rou padingi-en ki Joden makka-Jerusalem ta Tama-Pichik ki Leviten-appa pa-taligh tyni-æn; Timang kow?
S.TRANSL: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
約翰所作的見證記在下面：猶太人從耶路撒冷差祭司和利未人到約翰那裏，問他說：「你是誰？」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mattæ'idungdung ta teni, ka assi ni-rmau; ka ni-dmungdung mattæ'i-kma-hina, Assi ti jau ta ti Christus.
S.TRANSL: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
他就明說，並不隱瞞，明說：「我不是基督。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-teitaligh nein tyni-æn, na mang-lava? ti Elias kow kaua? ka ni-koumma ta teni, assi-koh [ti anna ]: Tama-Mattæ'i-Tan kow kaua? ka ni-mattæ'i-vli ta teni, Assi.
S.TRANSL: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
他們又問他說：「這樣，你是誰呢？是以利亞嗎？」他說：「我不是。」「是那先知嗎？」他回答說：「不是。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta neni tyni-an: Timang kow-ra? alei ka pattæ'i-vli-en-mi-æn ki sou neini-æn, ka ni-madingi ymiæn-æn, mang koumma kow ymhou-an mamado?
S.TRANSL: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
於是他們說：「你到底是誰，叫我們好回覆差我們來的人。你自己說，你是誰？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma: ti jau ta yngau ki Makou-langæh tou poulæpou-læh-da: peitiktik-au pakahapou-hap ta darang ki MEIRANG, mama ki ni pa-sousou-en ti E-saïas ka na Mattæ'i-Tan.
S.TRANSL: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
他說：「我就是那在曠野有人聲喊着說：『修直主的道路』，正如先知以賽亞所說的。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-padingi-en na Fa-riseen ta neni.
S.TRANSL: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
那些人是法利賽人差來的；

S.FORM: Ka ni-tmaligh tyni-æn, ka ni kma tyni-æn ta neni: Ka oumang ka mæulough-kow, rou assi kow ti Christus, assi ti Elias, assi ki Tama-Mattæ̈'i-Tan-da?
S.TRANSL: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
他們就問他說：「你既不是基督，不是以利亞，也不是那先知，為甚麼施洗呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli neini-æn ta ti Joannes, k'ma, Ti jau ta mæu-lough ki raloum, ra mou-ryppat myttouhko ymoumi-æn, ka assi-moumi kalang-in da.
S.TRANSL: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
約翰回答說：「我是用水施洗，但有一位站在你們中間，是你們不認識的，

S.FORM: Teni ta ti anna ka si-æ̈'üh ierroua jau-an, ka ni-kæu'-euro jau-an-da, ka assi koh tou kei-rang-en ki kidi, ki 'æeu-sasyk't-an-ei-mau ta rapas ki tatapyl-tyn.
S.TRANSL: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
就是那在我以後來的，我給他解鞋帶也不配。」

S.FORM: Ni-mamut ta atta tou Be-thabara tou arouh ki Jordaen, ka mæ̈-u-lou-u-loug ta ti Joannes tou hynna.
S.TRANSL: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
這是在約旦河外伯大尼，約翰施洗的地方作的見證。

S.FORM: Tou sasat-appa ki wæ'i ka tou æ̈'uh ni-k'yttan ti Joannes ta ti Jesus ka mouqua tyni-æn, ka kma; Kyttei ta patak ki i-ou-kò ki Alid, ka tama-eu-mia ki va-rau ki ymmud ki Næi-ra.
S.TRANSL: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
次日，約翰看見耶穌來到他那裏，就說：「看哪，上帝的羔羊，除去世人罪孽的！

S.FORM: Teni ta ti atta ka ni-qua-au; si-æ̈uh jau-an iroua ta paræh, ka ni-keuh-euro-jau-an, alei ka i-tou-ouro jau-an-da.
S.TRANSL: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
這就是我曾說：『有一位在我以後來、反成了在我以前的，因他本來在我以前。』

S.FORM: Ka assi koh ni-kmalang tyni-æn, râ tou pou-pænæ'-hen paka-vana tyni-æn ki Israel, alei ki anna iroua-to koh mæ̈uleuü-lugh ki raloum.
S.TRANSL: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
我先前不認識他，如今我來用水施洗，為要叫他顯明給以色列人。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mattæ'i-hail ta ti Joannes, kma; ni-k'yttâ-'n-nau ta Joep-an ka mou-rarum makka-tounnoun, mama ki padæuh mæ̈yli itou-halap tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
約翰又作見證說：「我曾看見聖靈，彷彿鴿子從天降下，住在他的身上。

S.FORM: Ka assi-mau kalang-en ta teni, râ teni ka ni-madingi jau-an pæ-'ulough ki raloum, teni ta ni-k'ma jau-an, timang ta kytt'ei-'mhou 'tqua mou-rarim mou-ha-lap tyni-æn ta Joep-an, mæ-yli-appa mahgalap tyniæn, teni k'atta ta meulough ki Joep-an ka D'lligh Matiktik.
S.TRANSL: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
我先前不認識他，只是那差我來用水施洗的、對我說：『你看見聖靈降下來，住在誰的身上，誰就是用聖靈施洗的。』

S.FORM: Ka ti jau ta ni-kmytta, ka ni-mattæ'i-hail-koh, ka Alak ki Alid ta ti atta-ra.
S.TRANSL: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
我看見了，就證明這是上帝的兒子。」

S.FORM: Tou sasat-appa ki we'i ka tou æ̈'ugh ni-mila mitouhko ta ti Joannes, ki rarouha-appa ki Pahtatæutæu'-en tyn.
S.TRANSL: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
再次日，約翰同兩個門徒站在那裏。

S.FORM: Ka rou ararau-en tyn ti Jesus-an ka mau-naunang, ni-k'ma ta teni: K'yttei ta patak ki i-ouko ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
他見耶穌行走，就說：「看哪，這是上帝的羔羊！」

S.FORM: Ka ni-millingig ta rarou-ha ki Pahtatæutæu-en ki sou tyn, ka ni-mæ'-u-uh ti Jesusan.
S.TRANSL: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
兩個門徒聽見他的話，就跟從了耶穌。

S.FORM: Irou ka mææu-veiryng ta ti Jesus ka rou kmytta ki mæ-u-uh tyni-æn, ni-k'ma-neini-an;
S.TRANSL: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them,
耶穌轉過身來，看見他們跟着，就問他們說：

S.FORM: Kamang ta k'i'ym-'nou-mi? neni-ra ni-kma tyniæn, Rab-bi (ka rou paha-biri-viri teni ki sou ki Mæhta-tæutæuuh) i-tou-kakouna kow?
S.TRANSL: What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
「你們要甚麼？」他們說：「拉比，在哪裏住？」（拉比翻出來就是夫子。）

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma neini-æn; 'Ou-qu'au, kmytta-ato. Ka ni-'ou-qua ka ni-kytt'an nein i-tou-kouna ta teni, ka ni-mi-sasaun tyni-æn sat ki wæ'i k'anna. Ka tou hivat-ato ki sat kyttiæn ki tæ'lei.
S.TRANSL: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
耶穌說：「你們來看。」他們就去看他在哪裏住，這一天便與他同住；那時約有申正了。

S.FORM: Ti Andreas ka ta'i-a-para ti Simon Petrus ta saät ki rarouha [ki vouat] ka ni-millingigh ki at-ta ti Joannes-an, ka ni-mæ-u-ugh tyni-an.
S.TRANSL: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
聽見約翰的話跟從耶穌的那兩個人，一個是西門‧彼得的兄弟安得烈。

S.FORM: Ti atta ta ni-kma'-ouro kma-balei ki tæ'i-apara tyn ka d'lligh ka ti Simon, ka ni-k'ma tyni-æn; Ni-tau-valei-nian ta ti Messias, att'-ato dou pahabiri-viri-en ki sou ta [ni-voulou ka] ti Christus.
S.TRANSL: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
他先找着自己的哥哥西門，對他說：「我們遇見彌賽亞了。」（彌賽亞翻出來就是基督。）

S.FORM: Ka ni-d'ilough tyn tyni-æn p'ou-qua ti Jesus-an. Ka tou ararau-en ti Jesus tyni-an, ni-k'ma; Ti Simon kow, alak ti Jo-na: ka pananang-eih-kow Cefas, ka paha-viri-biri-en ki sou ta [vah-tou, ka] ti Petrus.
S.TRANSL: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
於是領他去見耶穌。耶穌看着他，說：「你是約翰的兒子西門，你要稱為磯法。」（磯法翻出來就是彼得。）

S.FORM: Tou æ̈'uh ki wæ'i ni-ma-moei ta ti Jesus thabul mou-qua tou Galilæa, ka ni-kabalei tyn ta ti Filippus, ka ni-kma tyni-æn, Mæ-æu-uh-ha jau-an-da.
S.TRANSL: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
又次日，耶穌想要往加利利去，遇見腓力，就對他說：「來跟從我吧。」

S.FORM: Ka makka Bethsaïda ta ti Filippus, na euma ti Andreas, ti Petrus.
S.TRANSL: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
這腓力是伯賽大人，和安得烈、彼得同城。

S.FORM: Ni-kmabalei ta ti Filip-pus ti Nathanaël-an, ka kma tyni-æn; Ni-tau-valei-niæn [ta ti anna] ka ni-s'oulat-tin ti Mo-ses tou Tatouhko, ki Tama-Mat-tæ'i-Tan-appa [atta] ta ti Jesus k'allak ti Josef, ka makka Naza-reth.
S.TRANSL: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
腓力找着拿但業，對他說：「摩西在律法上所寫的和眾先知所記的那一位，我們遇見了，就是約瑟的兒子拿撒勒人耶穌。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta ti Nathanaël tyni-æn, gma'lpouh kaua yrroua ta mamamang ka mariang makka Nazareth? Ni-k'ma ta ti Filippus tyni-æn,'ou-qu-au, k'yttei.
S.TRANSL: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
拿但業對他說：「拿撒勒還能出甚麼好的嗎？」腓力說：「你來看！」

S.FORM: Ka ni-kmytta ta ti Jesus ti Nathanaël-an ka mou-qua ty-ni-æn, ka ni-mattæ'i-mimia tyni-æn, K'yttei d'lligh ta Israëlyt, ka a'oussi ki si-vanavan'-an tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
耶穌看見拿但業來，就指着他說：「看哪，這是個真以色列人，他心裏是沒有詭詐的。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Nathanaël ty-ni-æn, a'i kouan ka kmalang kow jau-an? Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus kma tyni-æn, Si-ourou ki ni-ta-tam-en ymhou-an ti Filippus, dou itouqua-appa kow tou n'gara ki lakæuoung-in, ka k'ytt'-tan-au kow.
S.TRANSL: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
拿但業對耶穌說：「你從哪裏知道我呢？」耶穌回答說：「腓力還沒有招呼你，你在無花果樹底下，我就看見你了。」

S.FORM: Ni-matta'i-vli ta ti Natha-naël ka kma tyni-æn, Rabbi, ym-hou ta Alak ki Alid, ymhou ta Meisasou ka si-bavau ki Israel.
S.TRANSL: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
拿但業說：「拉比，你是上帝的兒子，你是以色列的王！」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus ni-kma tyni-æn; Alei ka ni-pa-sousou-en-nau ymhouan, Ni-kyt-ta-en-nau kow tou ngara ki lakæuoung-in , tna-msing-ato kow: kmytta-ah-kow ki masaoun irang ki atta.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
耶穌對他說：「因為我說『在無花果樹底下看見你』，你就信嗎？你將要看見比這更大的事」；

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma-tyni-æn, Mis-sing, missing koun-nau-ka mou-ra, na kidi hnyn kmyt-ah-kamou ki toun-noun ki vullum ka ni-lih touaf-vun ki Tama-Gnau-ap-pa ki Alid ka mou-vavau, ka mou-rarim-appa mou-halap ki Alak ki ka'eu-loung.
S.TRANSL: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
又說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們將要看見天開了，上帝的使者上去下來在人子身上。」
